disclosure: Diagnostic only — not a published SLO.
interpretation: BLAKE SHORT-CIRCUIT: no-blake 263689 vs full 139175 ops/s (1.9×) — **Blake is a major cook cost** (still memcpy+write).
APPEND SHORT-CIRCUIT: no-append 531612 vs full 139175 ops/s (3.8×) — if ratio ≫1, append_frame (Blake+buffer) is the data-cooking hog.
Blake vs full append: no-blake 263689 / no-append 531612 — gap is memcpy+frame framing+write after Blake is removed.
APPEND SC + no-index: 632937 ops/s (vs no-append-with-index 531612) — residual after skipping Blake/append.
INDEX BISECT: no-index 145312 ≈ full 139175 ops/s (ratio 1.04×) — dual-index publish is NOT the killer; **data cooking** (encode/append/Blake+copy + write) dominates.
DISK BISECT: Discard 173186 / DevNull 164525 / Real 139175 ops/s — partial OS cost (Real/Discard=0.80×).
Raw /dev/null 4251701 vs raw work-file 1014784 ops/s — pure write_all media delta without Residiuum.
Buffered put is 46% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory 979534 → Discard-Buffered 173186 → Real-Buffered 139175: gap Memory→Discard is **pre-disk store work**; Discard→Real is **tail I/O**.
Raw write_all 1014784 ops/s vs Buffered put 139175 — store adds 7.3× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Note: long peer multi-seal runs can still add seal_rotate wall; this micro uses 512MiB seal so mid seals are off.
